这种初学者友好的 Z-Image Turbo 一体式 Controlnet Union 工作流程可以使用用于姿势和风格指导（Canny/Depth）的参考图像生成新的输出图像，同时应用详细的文本提示来控制所需输出的最终外观。对于 ComfyUI 的任何早期采用者来说，这都更容易遵循，因为它不使用子图或过于复杂的流程。确保您拥有足够最新版本的 ComfyUI 和 ComfyUI 管理器来管理和安装任何缺少的依赖项（缺少节点、补丁等），以便正确使用它。此工作流程默认使用 Fp8 版本的 Z-Image Turbo 一体式模型，支持 Clip 和 VAE，这将在仅具有 16GB 统一内存的基础级 Apple Silicon Mac M 处理器（如 M3、M4、M5 等）或具有低端 Nvidia 和 AMD GPU/eGPU 的 PC 上运行良好。甚至在 8GB VRAM 上也能正常工作。但如果你想使用更大的 bf16 版本 我还在自述文件中提供了 Z-Image Turbo 一体式模型在更强大的系统上的链接。仅当您使用 CFG 1.2 和步骤 12 或更高版本（我发现 CFG 1.2 和 12 步骤组合产生更好的结果）来过滤掉您不想在输出中看到的内容时，否定提示才会在此工作流程中起作用（使用此工作流程的默认值以获得优化结果，只有在您确切知道自己想要什么时才进行更改）。在 AIO Aux 预处理器节点中，以下预处理器已被确认运行良好，强烈建议使用以获得最佳结果：

# CannyEdgePreprocessor - 用于使用 Canny 参考图像生成输出

# DepthAnythingPreprocessor - 用于生成带有深度参考图像的输出

# OpenposePreprocessor - 用于生成带有姿势参考图像的输出

# DWPreprocessor - 比标准 OpenPose 更准确的身体和手部跟踪输出

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的 Z-Image Turbo 型号，然后

#2.加载您的输入参考图像文件（.Png 或 .Jpg 或任何支持的文件）

＃3。然后输入您的提示（正面和负面）。

＃4。现在您可以选择合适的 AIO Aux 预处理器（Canny、Depth、Openpose.. 或仅使用默认的 - DWPreprocessor）

＃5。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃6。选择图像采样方法、cfg、步骤等设置（默认值 - CFG 1.2 和 12 步骤提供最优化的输出）

#7.最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样。

*** 如果您使用的是通过 Stability Matrix 管理的 ComfyUI，请确保下载 Z-Image Turbo Controlnet Union 模型补丁并将其放入 ComfyUI 包子文件夹本身的 models 子文件夹中，而不是 Stability Matrix 的通用模型子文件夹中。因此它将转到 <您的稳定性矩阵的数据文件夹>/Packages/ComfyUI/models/model_patches，而不是 <您的稳定性矩阵的数据文件夹>/Models/model_patches（共享通用模型的子文件夹，您通常在其中存储模型，以便它们可以在 ComfyUI、WebUI Forge 等之间共享。您可以通过稳定性矩阵安装和管理多个不同的工具）。如果您不能正确执行此操作，则此工作流程将无法工作。

o.en:
This beginner friendly Z-Image Turbo ALL-in-One Controlnet Union workflow can generate a new output image using a reference image for pose and style guidance (Canny/Depth), while applying detailed text prompts to control the final look of desired output. This is easier to follow for any early adopter of ComfyUI as it does not use sub-graphs or too complex processes. Make sure that you have latest enough versions of both ComfyUI and ComfyUI manager to manage and install any missing dependencies (missing nodes, patches etc.) to use this properly. This workflow by default uses Fp8 version of the Z-Image Turbo ALL-in-One Model which has Clip & VAE backed in, this will work well on base level Apple Silicon Mac M processors (like M3, M4, M5 etc.) with only 16GB unified memory or on a PC with low end Nvidia and AMD GPUs/eGPUs.. even on 8GB VRAM. But if you want to use bigger bf16 version of the Z-Image Turbo ALL-in-One Model on a more powerful system I also provided links in the readme file. Negative prompts will only work on this workflow if you use CFG of 1.2 and Steps 12 or higher (I have found CFG 1.2 & 12 Steps combo producing better results) to filter out what you don't want to see on your outputs (use the defaults of this workflow for optimized results, only change if you know exactly what you want). In the AIO Aux Preprocessor node, the following preprocessors have been confirmed to work well and are highly recommended for optimal results:

# CannyEdgePreprocessor - For generating output with a Canny Reference Image

# DepthAnythingPreprocessor - For generating output with a Depth Reference Image

# OpenposePreprocessor - For generating output with a Pose Refenence Image

# DWPreprocessor - For more accurate output than the standard OpenPose for body & hand tracking

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired Z-Image Turbo model first and then

#2. Load your input reference image file (.Png or .Jpg or anything supported )

#3. then input your prompts (positives and negatives).

#4. Now you may select an appropriate AIO Aux Preprocessor ( Canny, Depth, Openpose.. or just use the default - DWPreprocessor )

#5. select how many images you want ( Change the number besides the "Run" button )

#6. select image sampling methods, cfg, steps etc. settings ( Default values - CFG 1.2 & 12 Steps gives most optimized outputs )

#7. finally press the run button to generate. That's it.

*** If you are using a ComfyUI managed via Stability Matrix then make sure you download and put the Z-Image Turbo Controlnet Union model patch inside models subfolder of ComfyUI package subfolder itself, not the Stability Matrix's common models subfolder.. so it will go to <Your Stability Matrix's Data folder>/Packages/ComfyUI/models/model_patches not into <Your Stability Matrix's Data folder>/Models/model_patches (the shared common model's Subfolder where you commonly store models so they can be shared between ComfyUI, WebUI Forge etc ..multiple different tools you may install and manage via Stability Matrix). If you can't do this correctly this workflow will not work.
